app in bend2lean a spine f a b ...: drop the quantity arguments of known defs; apply a mat to its scrutinee
consume in bend2lean h applied to args: lambdas take them, λ-matches match them (or pick the arm of a known constructor)
deps in bend2lean strongly connected components, in dependency order (tarjan); a cycle is a mutual block
inductive in bend2lean a non-indexed datatype: parameters are its type's binders, fields the rest of each constructor
mat in bend2lean a chain of λ-matches on x; each arm's handler takes the fields, then the args in rest
self rec in bend2lean in a cycle, inline the members that do not call themselves into the others' bodies; the cycle then breaks into plain self-recursion (lean unfolds that, not mutual blocks)
tm in bend2lean a type or term; bend has one syntax for both
